plugin.name: Koola10 Synth
plugin.render_notes: Standard VST3 stereo audio out. No proprietary or wrapped formats are produced.

parameters.name: Wavetable Position
parameters.description: Moves through the 2048-sample frames of the loaded wavetable, linearly crossfading between the two neighbouring frames. 0 is the first frame, 1 is the last. Reads as a percentage.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Cutoff frequency of the post-oscillator low-pass filter (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter). The knob readout shows kHz. Opens at 2.50 kHz on first launch so the synth is audible without touching a knob.

parameters.name: Filter Resonance
parameters.description: Emphasis around the cutoff frequency. 0.707 is neutral in JUCE terms (shown as 0 %); higher values ring and self-oscillate. Reads as a percentage.

parameters.name: Amp Attack
parameters.description: Time taken to reach full level after a note starts. Reads as a percentage of the knob's travel.

parameters.name: Amp Decay
parameters.description: Time taken to fall from full level to the sustain level. Reads as a percentage of the knob's travel.

parameters.name: Amp Sustain
parameters.description: Held level while a note is held down, after attack and decay have finished. Reads as a percentage.

parameters.name: Amp Release
parameters.description: Time taken to fade to silence after the key is released. Reads as a percentage of the knob's travel.

parameters.name: Master Level
parameters.description: Final output level (a linear 0..1 level, shown as a percentage) applied after the amplifier envelope. 70 % on first launch so the synth is audible immediately.

factory_waves.note: 24 single-cycle wavetables, 2048 samples, mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz, embedded in the plugin binary with juce_add_binary_data. Regenerate with plugin-juce/factory_waves_gen.py.

non_automatable_state.name: Wavetable File
non_automatable_state.description: Absolute path of a user-loaded .wav wavetable, stored in the plugin state so a session recalls the same table.

non_automatable_state.name: Factory Wave
non_automatable_state.description: Name of the selected built-in wave (for example "Classic Saw"), stored alongside wavetable_file so the browser selection round-trips.

non_automatable_state.name: Preset Name
non_automatable_state.description: Name of the active factory preset, or the name stored in a user .koola10preset file.
